pages.title: Set up a lift
pages.text: Place an Elevator with a clear vertical shaft. Set its height in the hologram. Elevators work automatically and need no power supply.$(br2)Stand in the beam. Without multiple marked floors, Jump rises and Sneak descends.

pages.title: Add landing markers
pages.text: Place Level Markers at landing heights, within two blocks horizontally of the elevator and inside its configured height.$(br2)With multiple detected floors, Jump and Sneak select the next higher or lower floor. The beam hologram also offers clickable floor buttons.$(br2)Keep the shaft and each landing clear.

pages.title: Name and choose floors
pages.text: Right-click a Level Marker and click Floor name to type (up to 32 characters). Esc or clicking outside saves it. Leave empty for a numbered floor.$(br2)The beam hologram shows five floors at a time. Use its arrows to scroll, then click a floor to travel there.$(br2)The floor nearest your height has a gray box around its row and brighter text. The highlight updates as you travel.
